## Summary

What does this change do, and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature or behavior change
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Tests only
- [ ] Maintenance / tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) (developer copy, maintenance mode for A-FC edits, branch from `dev` for ongoing work).
- [ ] No secrets, personal paths, or private project data in the diff.
- [ ] If this changes user-visible behavior, the README or skills were updated when needed.

## Testing

How did you verify this (commands, manual steps)?

## Notes for reviewers

Anything optional: related issues, follow-ups, or rollout order (e.g. guard changes and the daily `A-FC` folder).
